title: What atoms are connected in single type bonds?
question: What atoms are connected in single type bonds?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN BondDetails AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
